evals.name: expose-rap-projection-as-odata-v4
evals.prompt: I have a RAP business object and want to expose its projection for a new Fiori Elements app. Give me the OData V4 service-definition and service-binding steps.
evals.expected_output: Recommends exposing projection CDS views from a service definition, creating an OData V4 UI service binding, activating and publishing it, and using preview to verify the service.

evals.name: distinguish-external-service-consumption
evals.prompt: My ABAP Cloud class needs to call a partner's external OData API through a communication arrangement. Explain the consumption approach, not how to expose my RAP BO.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes external OData consumption, describes the ABAP Cloud HTTP/client-proxy and communication-arrangement path as appropriate, and does not give only RAP service exposure steps.
